# Figure plan (generated by tools/design_docs.py from figure_plan.py; do not edit by hand)

Two sets. **Headline** (`outputs/headline/`): the figures of the paper, double column (183 mm), PNG 300 dpi and vector PDF, with `HEADLINE.md` (findings and every figure with its caption). **Diagnostics** (`outputs/diagnostics/<group>/`): every other figure, PNG 300 dpi, indexed in `DIAGNOSTICS.md`. All figures use `style.py` (docs/PALETTE.md) and the vocabulary of `naming.py` (docs/RENAMING.md). Caption numbers are read from the data files when the figure is drawn.

## Headline set

### H1. How the model works

* File: `outputs/headline/H1_model_schematic.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: one panel: people -> households -> dwellings -> floor area -> embodied carbon -> AESA boundaries (AR, AtP); the demand bands branch off the dwellings step, each pathway lever (L1-L5) is attached to the band or quantity it acts on (L1 extra space; L2 vacancy, L3 2026 overbuild; L4 replacement and redevelopment; L5 carbon per m2); TL1-TL6 shown as the limits of the same arrows; untargeted bands (population growth, smaller households) marked
* Data: naming.py, levers.py (structure only; no numbers)
* Draft caption: Model structure. A bottom-up chain converts population and household projections into dwellings required, floor area by reason for building (demand bands) and embodied carbon, which is compared with two allocations of a global carrying capacity (acquired rights, AR; ability to pay, AtP). Pathway levers act on the band or quantity they target; population growth and smaller households are untargeted by design.
* Replaces (v3.1): new

### H2. New residential floor area, 1991-2050

* File: `outputs/headline/H2_floor_area.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: (a) annual floor area built: history 1991-2025 (consents x completion rate), Reference projection 2026-2050 with the Monte Carlo 5-95% band, Low and High replacement variants; (b) cumulative floor area 2026-2050 by variant (bar) with the Monte Carlo 5-95% whisker on the Reference
* Data: data/baseline/projection.json, data/baseline/scenarios.json, data/montecarlo/annual_REF.csv, data/montecarlo/summary_REF.csv
* Draft caption: New residential floor area. History is consented floor area converted to built floor area; the Reference projection builds {gfa_ref:.1f} million m2 in 2026-2050 (Monte Carlo 90% interval {gfa_p5:.1f}-{gfa_p95:.1f}); Low and High replacement bracket the replacement assumption ({gfa_low:.1f} and {gfa_high:.1f}).
* Replaces (v3.1): boss_03_cumulative_gfa, fig_scenarios, mc_1_fan

### H3. Why floor area is built

* File: `outputs/headline/H3_demand_bands.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: annual floor area by demand band: history as one bar per census interval (interval means, one vacancy definition), Reference projection annual 2026-2050; bands stacked (they sum to the total; no separate total line); untargeted bands grey and hatched; retirement villages removed in proportion (out of scope, noted)
* Data: data/baseline/projection.json (bands), history by census interval from the Boss state
* Draft caption: Floor area by reason for building. Bands sum to the in-scope total. Population growth and smaller households are untargeted; extra space, vacancy and the 2026 overbuild, replacement and redevelopment are the bands the pathways act on.
* Replaces (v3.1): diag_4_floor_area, boss_04_annual_gfa, fig_bridge

### H4. Embodied carbon 2026-2050 by component

* File: `outputs/headline/H4_carbon_components.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: (a) annual embodied carbon of the Reference by component (materials and construction A1-A5, soil carbon loss, maintenance B2/B4 within 2026-2050), stacked, with the Monte Carlo 5-95% band of the total; (b) cumulative 2026-2050 by material (Pride-stripe order) with committed after 2050 as a hatched companion range
* Data: data/baseline/projection.json (stages, materials, committed), data/montecarlo/annual_REF.csv
* Draft caption: Embodied carbon of new residential construction. Materials and construction (A1-A5) and soil carbon loss are counted in the construction year, maintenance (B2, B4) in the year it occurs within 2026-2050; later events and end of life are committed after 2050 (b, hatched).
* Replaces (v3.1): boss_05_annual_carbon, boss_06_cumulative_carbon, boss_10_material_flows, diag_5_carbon

### H5. Reference emissions against the AR and AtP boundaries

* File: `outputs/headline/H5_boundaries.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: (a) annual embodied carbon of the Reference (Monte Carlo band) against the annual AR and AtP boundaries; (b) cumulative level of exceedance 2026-2050, AR and AtP shown side by side as a range of principles (never averaged), for Low, Reference and High with Monte Carlo 5-95% whiskers
* Data: data/aesa/annual.csv, data/aesa/montecarlo_annual.csv, data/aesa/results.json
* Draft caption: Absolute sustainability. Over 2026-2050 the Reference exceeds the acquired-rights boundary {loe_ar:.2f}-fold and the ability-to-pay boundary {loe_atp:.1f}-fold; the two allocation principles are reported side by side and never averaged.
* Replaces (v3.1): pb_2_loe, boss_05_annual_carbon_pb, fig_scenarios_pb

### H6. Lock-in: emissions committed after 2050

* File: `outputs/headline/H6_committed.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: cumulative carbon within 2026-2050 (materials and construction, soil, maintenance) and the emissions committed after 2050 (later B2/B4 and C1-C4, lower-upper range, hatched) for Low, Reference and High, in kt and in years of the 2050 AR boundary; cumulative AR and AtP budgets as lines
* Data: data/aesa/results.json (committed), data/baseline/scenarios.json
* Draft caption: Lock-in. The 2026-2050 cohorts commit {com_lo:,.0f}-{com_hi:,.0f} kt after 2050 (Reference), equal to {yrs_lo:.0f}-{yrs_hi:.0f} years of the 2050 acquired-rights boundary.
* Replaces (v3.1): pb_6_committed

### H7. What each pathway removes, by demand band

* File: `outputs/headline/H7_pathways_bands.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: (a) floor area and (b) carbon 2026-2050 by demand band for the Reference, P1-P5 (Moderate bars, Ambitious whiskers on the total) and TL; untargeted bands grey and hatched at the bottom
* Data: data/pathways/bands.csv, data/pathways/runs.csv
* Draft caption: Pathways by demand band. Each pathway acts on the bands it targets; P4 lowers carbon per m2 of every band. TL: hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway.
* Replaces (v3.1): pw_1_bands_by_pathway

### H8. Annual emissions 2026-2050 against the boundaries

* File: `outputs/headline/H8_annual_emissions.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: one panel: Reference, P5 Moderate (solid), P5 Ambitious (dashed), TL (near-black) and TL gradual adoption (light) against the annual AR and AtP boundaries
* Data: data/pathways/annual.csv
* Draft caption: Annual embodied carbon of the combined pathways and the theoretical limit against the annual boundaries. TL: hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway.
* Replaces (v3.1): pw_4_annual_SI, pw_10_T_annual_SI

### H9. From the Reference to P5 Ambitious and TL

* File: `outputs/headline/H9_waterfall.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: order-free (Shapley) waterfall of cumulative carbon 2026-2050: Reference -> P1-P4 (Ambitious; Moderate shown as markers) -> P5 Ambitious -> full strength from 2027 -> TL1-TL6 -> TL, against the cumulative AR and AtP budgets; committed after 2050 as hatched companion bars for Reference, P5 Ambitious and TL; the TL residual to LoE AR = 1 annotated in dwellings not built and residents housed in existing dwellings
* Data: data/pathways/shapley_pathways.csv, data/pathways/shapley_theoretical_limit.csv, data/pathways/runs.csv, data/pathways/theoretical_limit.json
* Draft caption: Order-free attribution (Shapley values, exact). Even the theoretical limit exceeds the acquired-rights budget: closing the residual means {dw:,.0f} dwellings not built in 2027-2050 ({res:,.0f} residents housed in existing dwellings). TL: hyper-optimistic theoretical limit; a thought experiment, not a pathway.
* Replaces (v3.1): pw_2_shapley_waterfall, pw_8_staircase, pw_9_T_shapley_SI

### H10. Solution space: demand and intensity

* File: `outputs/headline/H10_solution_space.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: cumulative LoE AR over uniform cuts of 2027-2050 floor area (demand) and of non-soil carbon per m2 (intensity) applied to the Reference, with the LoE = 1 contour and 2, 3, 5, 10 contours; P1-P5 (Moderate open, Ambitious filled) and TL at their effective coordinates; back-cast points
* Data: data/pathways/solution_space.csv, data/pathways/backcast.json
* Draft caption: Solution space (after Horup et al. 2025, Fig. 6). Markers sit at each run's effective reductions of 2027-2050 floor area and non-soil carbon per m2; TL also lowers soil carbon (TL5, TL6), which the plane does not show.
* Replaces (v3.1): pw_3_solution_space

### H11. What moves the cumulative level of exceedance

* File: `outputs/headline/H11_sensitivity.png` / `.pdf`
* Panels: tornado of the cumulative LoE AR 2026-2050 (Reference), the largest parameters with both ends of paired parameters: model-input rows and AESA-method rows on one axis (see the note on population rows in docs/FIGURE_PLAN.md)
* Data: data/baseline/sensitivity_one_at_a_time.csv, data/aesa/sensitivity.csv
* Draft caption: One-at-a-time sensitivities of the cumulative acquired-rights level of exceedance; bars are not additive and not a joint interval.
* Replaces (v3.1): sens_1_tornado, pb_4_sensitivity

### Decisions (approved with the design documents)

* **H11, population rows: option A.** The one-at-a-time rows that change only the numerator of the LoE (every model-input row except population) convert exactly: cumulative LoE AR = Reference LoE x carbon / Reference carbon, because the boundaries depend on the population path only. The population 5th / 95th rows change the AR boundary as well (population modifier of Horup et al. 2025, Eq. 1): their LoE is computed with the existing boundary function (aesa.boundary_ar, aesa.boundary_atp) on each population path, with the exact engine carbon of that path. Two new values, flagged as additions (not changes) in the regression file and the CHANGELOG.
* **H10, TL marker: yes.** TL is placed at its effective coordinates (2027-2050 floor area and non-soil carbon per m2 of the TL run vs the Reference): two derived coordinates, computed exactly from the TL run, with the caveat in the caption that TL5 and TL6 lower soil carbon, which the plane does not show.
* **H4, annual components: yes.** The annual split into materials and construction (A1-A5), soil carbon loss and maintenance is exported as a new table (outputs/headline/H4_carbon_components.csv); it is an exact decomposition of the captured annual carbon (tested to sum to it exactly).
* **Added headline content.** No figure beyond H1-H11; the material breakdown joins H4 as panel (b) because it is the policy-relevant split of the same carbon, and the TL human-terms staircase stays in the diagnostics (D32) because H9 carries its residual.
* **Palette and figure plan:** approved as proposed (docs/PALETTE.md).
